description: List legislative processes that ended with the act being passed (uchwalone) in a term, with the title of the act as passed and the ELI and citation (Dz.U./M.P.) of the published act.

documentType.description: Type of the document, in Polish (e.g. projekt ustawy)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; defaults to 50

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

title.description: Phrase to search for in the title of the process, in Polish (e.g. podatek dochodowy)

name: get-passed-processes

ELI.description: European Legislation Identifier of the published act

address.description: Address of the published act in ISAP

displayAddress.description: Citation of the published act, e.g. Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1

documentType.description: Type of the document in Polish, e.g. projekt ustawy (bill)

number.description: Number of the print that started the process; the ID of the process

titleFinal.description: Title of the act as passed

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: List passed legislative processes
